concept: A heartbroken Hannah kneeling in silent prayer at the tabernacle, tears streaming down her face as divine light begins to break through the darkness around her
composition: Close-up of Hannah kneeling in the foreground with tears and folded hands, mid-shot composition with Priest Eli standing slightly behind and to the side with a knowing, blessing gesture; warm golden light descending from above toward Hannah creating a dramatic contrast with the shadowed surroundings
environment: Ancient tabernacle interior at Shiloh with stone pillars, dim torchlight, and a shaft of heavenly light piercing through the darkness from above
